threads.body: This file appears to be a `requirements.txt`-style list, but the diff indicates line-number prefixes were introduced on some lines (`19 |`, `22 |`) while other lines remain unprefixed. If those prefixes are actually present in the file (not just diff metadata), `pip` will fail to parse the requirements. Please remove any line-number/pipe prefixes so each line is just `package==version` (consistent with the surrounding lines).

The diff shows a line-number prefix (`1 |`) added to the first requirement line. If that text is actually in the file, `pip` will treat it as an invalid requirement. Ensure the file contains only valid requirement specifiers (no line numbers/pipes).
Same as the zero-code example: the diff indicates a `1 |` prefix. If this is in the file content, it will break `pip install -r`. Please remove any line-number/pipe prefixes from requirements lines.

The diff suggests a line-number prefix (`11 |`) was introduced on this requirement line. If present in the actual file, it will invalidate the requirements file for tooling that parses it (pip, pip-tools, etc.). Please keep this file as plain requirement specifiers without line-number/pipe prefixes.
